visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a white Sailor Moon graphic t-shirt, sits indoors on a grey sofa. She holds a gold-colored CANMAKE product box and speaks to the camera. She opens the box and pulls out a blue and gold cylindrical sunscreen powder brush. (2) She demonstrates the size of the product by holding it in her hand. She removes the cap to show a dark brown brush head. She points to a small transparent plastic plug inserted at the base of the bristles. (3) She unfolds the paper instruction manual from the box and reads it. She then uses her fingers to pull the transparent plug out of the brush. She twists the blue collar of the product, demonstrating how the bristles retract and extend. (4) She shakes the brush repeatedly against her open palm. Fine, light-colored powder particles appear on her palm. She brings her hand closer to the lens to show the powder texture. (5) She applies the brush to her face, sweeping it across her nose, cheeks, and forehead. She holds a small yellow mirror in her other hand to check the application. She shakes the brush again to show how the powder dispenses. (6) She provides a final commentary on the product's finish, holding the product next to her face while looking directly at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female voice speaks in Mandarin, introducing a product. Upbeat, mid-tempo electronic pop music with a steady rhythmic beat begins. There is a faint paper rustling sound. (2) The narrator continues explaining the product features. A mechanical plastic 'click' is audible as the product cap is manipulated. (3) The speaker's tone becomes more inquisitive. A sharp plastic 'snap' or 'pop' occurs as a plug is removed from the product. (4) Frequent, rhythmic 'thumping' or 'tapping' sounds are heard as the product is shaken against a palm. The woman reacts with high-arousal exclamations like 'Oh!' and 'Wow!'. (5) Soft friction-like 'brushing' sounds occur against the skin. The narrator describes the tactile sensation and texture of the powder. (6) A final set of shaking sounds occurs, followed by the woman's concluding summary. The video ends with a high-pitched 'ding' UI sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Unboxing -> Technical Demonstration -> Personal Evaluation -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a beauty product review and practical demonstration. The creator unboxes a Canmake Sunscreen Powder Brush, explains its unique mechanism (shaking to dispense powder through bristles), and tests it on her face to assess texture, ease of use, and efficacy for midday touch-ups.
